import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Reader in = new Reader();
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int[] a = in.na(3);
        int[] b = in.na(3);
        
        // Maximum wins for Alice
        int maxWins = Math.min(a[0], b[2]) + Math.min(a[1], b[0]) + Math.min(a[2], b[1]);
        
        // Minimum wins for Alice = n - maximum wins for Bob
        // Bob's wins: Bob's rock beats Alice's scissors, Bob's scissors beats Alice's paper, Bob's paper beats Alice's rock
        int bobWins = Math.min(b[0], a[2]) + Math.min(b[1], a[0]) + Math.min(b[2], a[1]);
        int minWins = n - bobWins;
        
        System.out.println(minWins + " " + maxWins);
    }
    
    static class Reader {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;
        
        public Reader() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }
        
        public int nextInt() {
            try {
                while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens()) {
                    st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
                }
                return Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            } catch (IOException e) {
                e.printStackTrace();
                return -1;
            }
        }
        
        public int[] na(int n) {
            int[] a = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] = nextInt();
            }
            return a;
        }
    }
}
